title: Operation TrueView Mission 2: Apparent horizon dip from stratospheric balloon altitudes — methods, calibration, and falsification tests
description: Methods note and telemetry-recovery addendum for the Mission 2 stratospheric horizon dip audit: water-tube-referenced opposed-camera imaging, extinction-rim (Koschmieder) model, tangent-floor falsification test, uncertainty budget, METAR-validated apogee, and Mission 3 validation plan.
